name: Parambhaav Tech
elevator_pitch: Parambhaav Tech helps growing businesses simplify operations and embrace digital ways of working. From real estate and education technology to tailored digital services, we make technology practical for the people who use it every day.
_color_notes: Monochrome first. Silver is an accent only - never long body copy. Muted grey never as text on dark backgrounds.

contrast_pairs.use: muted grey: decorative only (rules, bullets, chart fills) - WCAG 1.4.11 non-text 3:1. Never text: it is 4.39:1 on white

do: Explain technology in plain business language
Lead with business outcomes: time saved, better visibility, simpler workflows
Be confident, clear, practical, dependable and human
Every claim and number traceable to a cited source
Show global examples first, then translate them into practical steps for Indian businesses
Keep amounts in the currency the source uses (USD, EUR, INR in lakh/crore); never convert
dont: Hype words (revolutionary, game-changing, disrupt, unleash, supercharge)
Invented India figures - India-specific claims need their own Indian source
voice.closing_section_heading: What this means for Indian businesses

ai_image_style: Editorial illustration for a premium technology consultancy. Strictly monochrome palette: near-black #090A0C, charcoal #17191D, cool silver #D9DDE2, silver shadow #AEB4BC, white. Clean geometric shapes, generous negative space, strong alignment, soft subtle gradients only, brushed-metal silver accents, calm and modern, real business settings (offices, property, classrooms, teams) rendered in a refined minimal style. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks or UI copy anywhere in the image. No bright colours, no neon, no clip-art, no hype imagery.

market.readers: owners and leaders of medium-sized, often traditional businesses in India
market.editorial_angle: Explore the technology across the globe (US, Europe, China, Southeast Asia, Middle East, India) with real examples, then close with how Indian businesses can apply it.
